cards.name: Eureka Moment
cards.oracleText: Draw two cards. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Moment of Truth
cards.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand, one into your graveyard, and one on the bottom of your library.

cards.name: Moment of Heroism
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink until end of turn. (Damage dealt by the creature also causes its controller to gain that much life.)

cards.name: Moment of Reckoning
cards.oracleText:
Choose up to four. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Destroy target nonland permanent.
• Return target nonland permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Momentum Rumbler
cards.oracleText:
Whenever this creature attacks, if it doesn't have first strike, put a first strike counter on it.
Whenever this creature attacks, if it has first strike, it gains double strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Momentary Blink
cards.oracleText:
Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Flashback {3}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Momentous Fall
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
You draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then you gain life equal to its toughness.

cards.name: Moment of Triumph
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Moment's Peace
cards.oracleText:
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.
Flashback {2}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Moment of Silence
cards.oracleText: Target player skips their next combat phase this turn.

cards.name: Moment of Defiance
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Momentum
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a growth counter on this Aura.
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each growth counter on this Aura.

cards.name: Moment of Valor
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Untap target creature. It gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Moment of Craving
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Momentum Breaker
cards.oracleText:
Start your engines! (If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.)
When this enchantment enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature or Vehicle of their choice. Each opponent who can't discards a card.
{2}, Sacrifice this enchantment: You gain life equal to your speed.
